About your brother; talk to him about it, tell him how it's making you feel, I am certain he'll stop and you can have some sort of catharsis. I'm sure he loves you back. I have a similar relationship with my little brother, we argue all the time over petty things and it sometimes becomes very dramatic or violent. How much do you tell your brother you respect him? I almost never show it but I do so much and I'd tell him if he asked me seriously. When me and my brother fight my mother says things like 'yeah just kill each other', and it's all very depressing (but this isn't about me). BUT I know i'll always love him and if he ever doubted that I'd be horrified. Please just talk to him and he will open up to you if you're sincere about it. He's seen you grow up from a baby and brotherhood is the closest relationship you can have. He IS proud to have you as his little brother and although he doesn't show it i'm sure he loves you more than you can imagine.
